menu.label: GameSwitcher
menu.description: Off: GUIDE opens the in-game menu and GameSwitcher is hidden

menu.label: Double tap
menu.description: Two GUIDE taps switch to the previous game

menu.label: Resume at power on
menu.description: After holding POWER in a game, the next power on resumes it

menu.label: Battery warning (%)
menu.description: A warning shows in games below this battery level

menu.label: Critical battery (%)
menu.description: At this level the game is saved and closed

menu.label: Games in history
menu.description: Older games leave GameSwitcher and their checkpoints are deleted

menu.label: Systems
menu.description: Choose which systems' games use GameSwitcher

menu.label: Clear history
menu.description: Hides every card and deletes the checkpoints; play time stays

menu.label: Reset play time
menu.description: Sets the play time of every game to zero
